narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran as one. In month {fork_month}, with the bonus in hand and your cousin's fee unmentioned on the table, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. The first score to come apart was {first_bar_apart}, in month {first_bar_apart_month}, the way the days themselves felt. The ghost's money reached its low point in month {ghost_lowest_month}. By month {end_month} the ghost's net worth was {net_worth_gap}. Its days had settled back to match yours, with Life {life_gap}.
